an11.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
an11.11:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.11:1.5: sambahulā kira bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.11:2.1: Atha kho Mahānāmo Sakko yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Mahānāmo Sakko Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an11.11:2.3: sambahulā kira bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.11:2.5: Tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharataṃ ken' assa vihārena vihātabban ti? 2.
an11.11:3.2: etaṃ kho Mahānāma tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ, yaṃ tumhe Tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyātha
an11.11:3.3: ‘tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharataṃ ken' assa vihārena vihātabban' ti.
an11.11:3.4: Saddho kho Mahānāma ārādhako hoti no asaddho,
an11.11:3.9: Imesu kho tvaṃ Mahānāma pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cha dhamme uttariṃ bhāveyyāsi. 3.
an11.11:3.11: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti.
an11.11:3.12: Yasmiṃ Mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako Tathāgataṃ anussarati, nev' assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an11.11:3.13: ujugatam ev' assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti Tathāgataṃ ārabbha,
an11.11:3.14: ujugatacitto kho pana Mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ,
an11.11:3.15: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an11.11:3.16: Ayaṃ vuccati Mahānāma ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, savyāpajjhāya pajāya avyāpajjho viharati, dhammasotasamāpanno buddhānussatiṃ bhāveti. 4.
an11.11:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ tvaṃ Mahānāma dhammaṃ anussareyyāsi
an11.11:4.2: ‘svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī' ti.
an11.11:4.3: Yasmiṃ Mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati, nev' assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an11.11:4.4: ujugatam ev' assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti dhammaṃ ārabbha,
an11.11:4.5: ujugatacitto kho pana Mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ,
an11.11:4.6: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an11.11:4.7: Ayaṃ vuccati Mahānāma ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, savyāpajjhāya pajāya avyāpajjho viharati, dhammasotasamāpanno dhammānussatiṃ bhāveti. 5.
an11.11:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ tvaṃ Mahānāma saṅghaṃ anussareyyāsi
an11.11:5.2: ‘supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujupaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyapaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcipaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yad idaṃ cattāri purisayugāni, aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esā Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā' ti.
an11.11:5.3: Yasmiṃ Mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati, nev' assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an11.11:5.4: ujugatam ev' assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti saṅghaṃ ārabbha,
an11.11:5.5: ujugatacitto kho pana Mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ,
an11.11:5.6: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an11.11:5.7: Ayaṃ vuccati Mahānāma ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, savyāpajjhāya pajāya avyāpajjho viharati, dhammasotasamāpanno saṅghānussatiṃ bhāveti. 6.
an11.11:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ tvaṃ Mahānāma attano sīlāni anussareyyāsi ‘akkhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññūpasaṭṭhāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikānī' ti.
an11.11:6.2: Yasmiṃ Mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako sīlaṃ anussarati, nev' assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an11.11:6.3: ujugatam ev' assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti sīlaṃ ārabbha,
an11.11:6.4: ujugatacitto kho pana Mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ,
an11.11:6.5: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an11.11:6.6: Ayaṃ vuccati Mahānāma ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, savyāpajjhāya pajāya avyāpajjho viharati, dhammasotasamāpanno sīlānussatiṃ bhāveti. 7.
an11.11:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ tvaṃ Mahānāma attano cāgaṃ anussareyyāsi
an11.11:7.3: yo 'haṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmi muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato' ti.
an11.11:7.4: Yasmiṃ Mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako cāgaṃ anussarati, nev' assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an11.11:7.5: ujugatam ev' assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti cāgaṃ ārabbha,
an11.11:7.6: ujugatacitto kho pana Mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ,
an11.11:7.7: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an11.11:7.8: Ayaṃ vuccati Mahānāma ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati savyāpajjhāya pajāya avyāpajjho viharati, dhammasotasamāpanno cāgānussatiṃ bhāveti. 8.
an11.11:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ tvaṃ Mahānāma devatā anussareyyāsi
an11.11:8.2: ‘santi devā Cātummahārājikā, santi devā Tāvatiṃsā, santi devā Yāmā, santi devā Tusitā, santi devā Nimmānaratino, santi devā Paranimmitavasavattino, santi devā Brahmakāyikā, santi devā Tatuttari;
an11.11:8.3: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayham pi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati;
an11.11:8.4: yathārūpena sīlena samannāgatā tā devatā cutā tattha upapannā, mayham pi tathārūpaṃ sīlaṃ saṃvijjati;
an11.11:8.5: yathārūpena sutena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayham pi tathārūpaṃ sutaṃ saṃvijjati;
an11.11:8.6: yathārūpena cāgena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayham pi tathārūpo cāgo saṃvijjati;
an11.11:8.7: yathārūpāya paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayham pi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatī' ti.
an11.11:8.8: Yasmiṃ Mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañ ca devatānaṃ saddhañ ca sīlañ ca sutañ ca cāgañ ca paññañ ca anussarati, nev' assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an11.11:8.9: ujugatam ev' assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti devatā ārabbha,
an11.11:8.10: ujugatacitto kho pana Mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ,
an11.11:8.11: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an11.11:8.12: Ayaṃ vuccati Mahānāma ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, savyāpajjhāya pajāya avyāpajjho viharati, dhammasotasamāpanno devatānussatiṃ bhāvetī
